hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$top/vsg.yaml" ] || exit 0; git check-ignore -q "$f" && exit 0; case "$f" in *.rs) out=$(rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f" 2>&1) ;; *.py) out=$(uvx ruff@0.16.8 format -q "$f" 2>&1) ;; *.vhd) out=$(uvx --from vsg==3.35.0 vsg -c "$top/vsg.yaml" --fix -of syntastic -f "$f" 2>&1) ;; *.md | *.json | *.yaml | *.yml) out=$(npx --yes prettier@3.9.8 --log-level warn --write "$f" 2>&1) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
